name: deepseek-editor
description: Local-first AI coding studio for Termux (Android)
author: Coffie

scripts.test: npm run check:server && npm run check:modules
scripts.verify: node -e "const p=['express','cors','ws','simple-git','@octokit/rest']; const ok=p.every(m=>{try{require.resolve(m);return true}catch{return false}}); console.log(ok?'✓ required deps present':'✗ missing required deps'); process.exit(ok?0:1)"
scripts.smoke: node -e "require('http').get('http://127.0.0.1:3002/api/health',r=>{let d='';r.on('data',c=>d+=c);r.on('end',()=>{try{const j=JSON.parse(d);console.log(j.ok?'✓ backend healthy':'✗ unhealthy',j);process.exit(j.ok?0:1)}catch(e){console.log('✗ bad response',d);process.exit(1)}})}).on('error',e=>{console.log('✗ backend not reachable:',e.message);process.exit(1)})"
